about_the_game:
The Supporter Pack is a small way to show your love for Len’s Island and help support the continued development of the game. 

Includes:

  • A prestigious golden build hammer - perfect for flexing while you build your dream island,

  • A shiny supporter badge on the main menu to proudly display your support,

  • Our eternal gratitude for helping us continue to build and improve Len’s Island into the future

Important Note:

This DLC is entirely cosmetic and completely optional. By purchasing the Supporter Pack, you're first and foremostly supporting us as developers – the golden hammer is just the cherry on top!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 or higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple M1/Intel Core M
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti (Maxwell or newer), 2 GB or AMD Radeon R7 360, 2 GB
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7, 4+ cores or Apple M2+
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070, 8 GB or AMD Radeon RX 590, 8 GB
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: If you want to show off fancy gold skins while supporting the developers of Len's Island, then look no further! Gain access to a fancy golden build hammer and a custom main-menu screen. This DLC is completely optional and cosmetic only.
